newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen mixed, rangebound again.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen mixed, rangebound again.

text.p: SPI Sycom cl 2590 -5 US 30yr cl 7.03 steady
*Stocks seen narrowly traded with broad market leads lacking. "I think it will be more of the same. There is not too much to get excited about," said a Brisbane-based dealer.
*On Wall Street, blue chips ended down as worries about long term interest rates generated some profit-taking, but techs and small caps managed gains as investors searched for growth.
*ADRs: News Corp 17-1/2 (+1/8), BHP 28-3/8 (+3/4), WMC 25-7/8 (+1/8), National Australia Bank 71-5/8 (-1/2)
*Gold price was steady. On LME copper prices finished strongly but the rest were mixed.
